::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/differential_prices"}
#docs
Each row names its `addon` and `plan`. Amounts are integer minor units.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The differential prices. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The differential price id. |
| `data.addon` | `string` | The add-on product. |
| `data.plan` | `string` | The plan the price applies to. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The currency code. |
| `data.interval` | `string` | The billing interval, or null for any interval. |
| `data.amountMinor` | `integer` | The unit amount in minor units, or null when `tiers` is set. |
| `data.tiers` | `array of object` | The tier table, or null when `amountMinor` is set. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A list of differential prices |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/differential_prices" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]

  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "dprice_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",

      "plan": "pro",

    }
  ]
}
```
